subGoals.rule: One command changes one aggregate instance; a second aggregate of another type (the stockroom) follows the completed job through a stored event (Vernon P4).
The labour cap (and its overrun approval) is an invariant of the repair job and is enforced inside the RepairJob aggregate (Vernon P4).

precedent: clean only: both stores already append pending events to one shared outbox in the same step as the change, and a relay delivers them after each command (booking notice on JobBooked).
